sets.name: AI label
sets.notes: Created 2026-08-29 on the Badge page, BESIDE the four AI surfaces the product invented locally (#269) rather than instead of them. No brand hue is picked: the ground is achromatic and the accent is a border and a glyph, so the branding decision lands on one value. Published: all 6 variants (origin × confidence) present in the 2026-09-15 components snapshot.

sets.name: Vertical outlined buttons
sets.notes: Maps to Button with fill=outline and vertical=true.

sets.name: Cascader
sets.notes: A `_Field` trigger over `_Listbox`, whose Body holds a Columns frame of equal `_Listbox Column`s of `Dropdown list Item` rows; a row with children shows caret-right in Trailing. state default · filled · open · disabled. In code the field is `_internal/Field.jsx` and each row is `_internal/OptionRow.jsx` with `OptionRow.Chevron` in Trailing. Built in the library and signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`.

sets.name: Choice Grid
sets.notes: Rebuilt on Form Checkbox and Form Radio Button with a `type` axis and a `_Choice Grid Row` part. The separate CheckBox Grid set (13541:9240) was deleted.

sets.name: ChoiceGroup
sets.notes: Four variants, type × orientation. Legend, then a row of Leading text, the Options slot (Form Radio Button or Form Checkbox, at least two) and Trailing text, then Other and Error. Replaces the deleted Multiple Choice (Radio) 13540:9207, Multiple Choice (Checkbox) 13540:9717 and Scale Radio Button 13536:6785. Linear Scale stays in the library, deprecated, until the Specs file swaps its six instances.

deliberate.appearance: Figma sets appearance on each Form Checkbox and Form Radio Button in the Options slot, since a group cannot reach into its slot; code sets it once on ChoiceGroup and passes it to every choice.
deliberate.description: Figma sets description on each choice in the Options slot; code takes it per option in `options` and passes it to that choice.

sets.name: Count
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page, beside the Counter set it replaces. Figma values carry a (default) suffix on subtle, neutral and medium; ring? is ring in code. Inverse exists in neutral only, and dot in medium only. Docs page: node 17883:1895.

sets.name: DateAndTimePicker
sets.notes: A date field and a `_Time Field` side by side with the time-zone caption beneath: state closed · date open · time open · read-only · disabled × validation none · invalid · success × filled? × size. The calendar is the shared `_Calendar` DatePicker opens, 4px (`gap-xs`) below the date field, left-aligned, flipping above. Signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`.

sets.name: _Time Field
sets.notes: The time half, state × filled? × size: hours, minutes and the AM/PM menu, which opens 4px (`gap-xs`) below. In code it lives inside `DateAndTimePicker.jsx`. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state.

sets.name: DatePicker
sets.notes: state closed · open · invalid · valid · read-only · disabled × filled? × range? × size. A `_Field` trigger with the calendar-day icon in Trailing; the open variants show `_Calendar` in `_Listbox` Body, 4px (`gap-xs`) below the field, left-aligned, flipping above when there is no room. `range` and `size` are the code props of the same names. Signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`.

sets.name: _Calendar
sets.notes: The month grid both pickers open, one variant per size. In code it is `_internal/Calendar.jsx`, which is not exported from the barrel. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state.

sets.name: _Calendar Day
sets.notes: One day cell: default, hover, selected, disabled, today, in range and outside the month, at three sizes. In code it is the day button inside `_internal/Calendar.jsx`. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state.

sets.name: Rating System (with text)
sets.notes: Was 13536:196, which resolves to nothing in the file. A plain COMPONENT, not a set. Re-read from the Rating page 2026-08-29.

sets.name: Scrollbar

sets.name: Select
sets.notes: 28 variants, mode (single · multi · multi (badges)) × state (closed · open · invalid · read-only · disabled) × filled?. Built on Form (`_Field`): Content holds `_Field Text`, or a TagGroup of removable Tags in multi; Trailing holds `_Field Clear` (18756:36409) and the `_Dropdown icon` caret; open variants float a `_Listbox` of Dropdown list Item rows. Searchable and creatable are list content (a `_Listbox Hint` header, a create row footer), not properties. Docs frame: Docs / Select 18729:33744.

deliberate.displayMode: Code has a third value, `text`, a comma-separated list with no Figma column; `badges` is kept on both sides until the screens that draw Badge chips move to Tags.

sets.name: Skeleton
sets.notes: On the Loading page. Figma has one preset property for shapes and presets alike (rect (default), circle, text, paragraph and the label presets); code splits it into shape and preset. shimmer? is isShimmering, off by default in Figma so static designs read clearly and on by default in code. Docs page: node 17885:47731.

sets.name: Status
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page, beside the Static Badges it replaces. Figma values carry a (default) suffix on state, neutral and medium. leadingVisual? and count? are booleans in Figma; in code leadingVisual takes the icon and count takes the number. Figma's label text is children. Date exists in neutral, warning and danger only. Docs page: node 17882:1647.

sets.name: Suggestion
sets.notes: On the AI Label page (docs page: node 17885:57). Figma marks defaults in the value name ("insert (default)", "rest (default)"); code takes the bare value. The state axis (rest, hover, pressed, focus) is the browser's own :hover, :active and :focus-visible, never a prop; state=disabled is the native disabled button, from a disabled field's or TagGroup's TagContext, never a prop.

sets.name: Table/Normal Border
sets.notes: Note the variant group is named `type` here, not `size` as in the borderless sets.

sets.name: Table/Contextual Color
sets.notes: Row state (disabled/focused/hovered/pressed) x semantic style (error/info/primary/success/warning). Code has no prop for this — apply it per cell via the cell object's `className`.

sets.name: Table/Background Color
sets.notes: 11 tinted row backgrounds including the SMART competency colors. Code has no prop — apply per cell via `className`.

sets.name: Tag
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page (docs page: node 17884:2099). Figma values carry a (default) suffix on gray, plain, read-only, rest and false. state=saving is isLoading; state=disabled comes from TagContext, never a prop; remove? on a link is link plus onRemove; count? is count. type is the same four values in code (plain, person, agent, team); the avatar slot is the avatar prop, with initials when it is missing. elevated=true is isElevated, drawn for read-only and link on plain, person, agent and team, including disabled (from TagContext) and focus × on a link's separate ×; code ignores it on removable and selectable with a warning.

sets.name: Remove button
sets.notes: On the Button page. Tag uses size small (16, 12px ×); its states are the × inside a removable tag. Medium and large are not built in code yet.

sets.name: TagGroup
sets.notes: On the Status, Count & Tag page (docs page: node 17884:2099). Figma values carry a (default) suffix on wrap, left and false. The Tags slot (preferred values Tag and Suggestion) is children. The +n is a gray behavior=selectable Tag with no swatch (TagGroup hides it); code sizes the collapsed row by width, where Figma draws two tags and +n. Suggestions are never counted into +n and stay after it; menu items keep their tag's action (selectable toggles, link opens with a trailing arrow); remove stays on the row.

sets.name: TagInput
sets.notes: 3 sizes × 10 states: empty, filled, focus, typing, create, option menu, reordering, invalid, read-only and disabled. `size` is the code prop of the same name. `state` draws code's live states still: empty and filled are the tags, focus and typing are focus and the typed text (the hovered row shows its "…" when the field has a menu handler), create is a Create row in the list, option menu is the `_Option menu` open from a row's "…" (`onRename`, `onDelete`, `onColorChange`), reordering is a row lifted by its handle with the drop line and the keys in the hint (`onReorder`), and invalid, read-only and disabled are `validation="invalid"`, `readOnly` and `disabled`. The rows are Dropdown list Item, whose `state=dragging` and `drop indicator?` are OptionRow's `dragging` and `dropIndicator="before"`. Signed off; the library publishes it once the Specs file's text migration is ready, and the status becomes `verified` then.

sets.name: _Option menu
sets.notes: The menu a TagInput row's "…" opens: a `_Listbox` whose Header holds a small field for the name, the Figma Form (code: `Input size="small"`, Enter renames, Esc cancels), and whose Body holds Dropdown list Item rows: Delete with a trash icon and a divider, then a Color heading and one row per Tag color showing the Tag, the current one `state=selected`. It opens 4px under the "…", right-aligned to it. Each part shows only when its handler is passed.

sets.name: Textarea
sets.notes: One set. Form Short Textarea was merged into it and deleted from the library; a text area is 80 high at least and grows from there. `rows` is code-only: Figma sets the height by resizing the instance.

sets.name: _Field
sets.notes: The part this component is built on: one box with Leading, Content and Trailing slots, 3 sizes × 7 states. In code it is `_internal/Field.jsx`, which is not exported from the barrel. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state rather than a step on the way to `verified`.

sets.name: Tile
sets.notes: On the Iconography, Logos & Imagery page. Figma marks defaults in the value name ("32 (default)", "subtle (default)", "gray (default)"); code takes the bare value. Logo and image variants hold a media slot, which code fills with `children` or `src`. Image variants exist for gray only, since the picture covers the ground.

sets.name: Top Bar
sets.notes: Names diverge across the boundary: Figma spells this `expand?` with boolean values, code spells it `mode` with 'expanded' | 'collapsed'. Verified against the TopBar props table in Storybook.

sets.name: Tree Select
sets.notes: A `_Field` trigger over `_Listbox`, whose Body holds a flat run of `Dropdown list Item` rows: state default · filled · open · disabled × multiple? false · true. In code the field is `_internal/Field.jsx` and each row is `_internal/OptionRow.jsx` in the `treeitem` role. Built in the library and signed off; it is `unpublished` until the library is next published, when it can move to `verified`.

sets.name: _Tree Indent
sets.notes: Part: the row's depth, level 1 · 2 · 3, in steps bound to `Tree/indent` (20px, aliasing space-400). In code it is `OptionRow.Indent`, depth × 20px. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state. Every row is `Dropdown list Item` (37:6472), the row OptionRow draws; its Leading slot holds this part.

sets.name: _Tree Toggle
sets.notes: Part: the caret, state collapsed · expanded · leaf (an empty cell of the same size, `Tree/toggle` 16px), with gap? before a checkbox. In code it is `OptionRow.Toggle`. The `_` prefix keeps the library from publishing it, so `unpublished` is its settled state. Every row is `Dropdown list Item` (37:6472), the row OptionRow draws; its Leading slot holds this part.
